caveats: To graduate with a minor in Sustainability, students must have enrolled in the Minor Program and complete a minimum total of 18 credits and all of its requirements, as well as the requirements of the major program of For credit transfer, students can transfer a maximum total of 6 credits to the Minor Program. Out of the total credits required by the minor program, at least 9 credits should be single-counted within the minor and are not used to fulfill any other requirements for graduation except the 120-credit degree Students may use no more than 9 credits earned from courses delivered in online mode, including HKUST self-paced online [SPO] courses and other online credits approved through the University’s credit transfer procedures, to satisfy the graduation requirements of a degree program.

Sustainability Electives [(5 courses from the specified elective list, out of which at least 1 course taken from each of the areas and at least 2 courses at 3000-level or above) Students of the 2022-23 intake and onwards may not use CIVL 1150 to count towards Area 2 of this elective requirement.] -- the credits and the course count are checked, but the extra condition in this sentence is not. Confirm it with your advisor.
OCES 2001: The course was last offered in 2024-25 and was deleted subsequently.
Elective(s): OCES 2001 is named in the requirement PDF but not in the 2026-27 course catalog, so it was left out of this check.
